holds.reason: Rosh Hashanah identifies Rabbah and Abaye with the house of Eli. It does not state the priestly designation directly for this Naḥmani, nor settle the identity of the bare entry 2704.

notes.text: The separate Rabbah entry and Sherira use the patronymic bar Naḥmani.
Ketubot reports the letter from Rabbah’s brothers without naming them. The Rabbah dossier identifies the brothers as these two; that identification belongs to Heilprin’s argument.
